T: Rumour has it dinner is good.
D: A clean-cut high school student lets a lie about her spread, and it takes on a life of its own.
P: Serve the mains when Olive sits down to dinner with her parents.
S: the red A Olive stitches onto her clothes
Pita bread cut into A shapes, brushed with olive oil and sumac, baked at 200C for 8 minutes, served with a roasted beetroot dip swirled with yoghurt.
the small town of Ojai, California
Green and black olives warmed in olive oil with strips of orange and lemon peel, garlic, chilli and fennel seed.
Todd in the school mascot suit
Soft pretzel bites boiled briefly in bicarb water, rock salt sprinkled on, baked at 220C for 12 minutes, with honey mustard.
M: Rice noodles fried with egg, tofu, tamarind and fish sauce, topped with peanuts and lime.
Flathead strips dusted in chilli and cumin, pan-fried, in corn tortillas with cabbage slaw, lime crema and sliced radish.
W: the bright red A on everything
Red velvet cake batter piped into rounds, baked at 180C for 10 minutes, sandwiched together with cream cheese frosting.
K: the song Olive can't get out of her head all weekend
Fresh lemon juice, sugar syrup and cold water with sliced lemons and mint in a big jug over ice.

s.note: the red A Olive stitches onto her clothes
s.how: Cut pita bread into A shapes, brush with olive oil and dust with sumac. Bake at 200C for 8 minutes until crisp. Blend 2 roasted beetroot with a crushed garlic clove and 200g Greek yoghurt, then swirl a little extra yoghurt through the top.

s.note: the small town of Ojai, California
s.how: Warm 150g green olives and 150g kalamata olives gently in olive oil with strips of orange and lemon peel, sliced garlic, a pinch of chilli and a teaspoon of fennel seeds for 5 minutes. Tip into a bowl and serve warm with toothpicks.

m.how: Soak 300g flat rice noodles. Fry 200g firm tofu and 2 garlic cloves, add 2 eggs and scramble. Add the noodles, 3 tbsp tamarind, 2 tbsp fish sauce and 2 tbsp brown sugar and toss. Finish with 150g bean sprouts, 60g crushed peanuts and lime.

w.note: the bright red A on everything
w.how: Whisk 250g flour, 2 tbsp cocoa, a teaspoon of bicarb, 150g sugar, an egg, 125ml oil, 250ml buttermilk and red colouring to a thick batter. Pipe rounds and bake at 180C for 10 minutes. Sandwich with cream cheese beaten with icing sugar.

d.note: the song Olive can't get out of her head all weekend
d.how: Dissolve 150g sugar in 150ml hot water and cool. Squeeze 6 lemons into a big jug and add the syrup with 1.5L cold water. Add sliced lemon, bruised mint leaves and plenty of ice. Stir and pour into tall glasses on a sunny afternoon.
